label: The max-plus recurrence
subgoals: Seed each startpoint with its launch arrival
Add each fanin's arrival to its arc delay
Keep the largest sum as the node's arrival

label: Propagating to the endpoints
subgoals: Apply the max recurrence at every node
Read the endpoint's arrival as its longest-path delay

label: Early arrivals for hold
subgoals: Seed each startpoint with its earliest launch time
Take the minimum over fanins of early arrival plus minimum delay
Store early and late arrivals together at every pin
